subject: Re: call later this week
text: Following up on your last note, I need to shift our call by about forty minutes. The original slot is still possible, but an unexpected delivery surcharge has arrived for the field equipment, and our finance queue will not release the confirmation until it is reconciled. I'd rather not talk over that, because it may affect the timeline you're trying to protect. Could we move to Thursday at 2:30? If that doesn't suit, Wednesday after two works for me, and I can keep the same agenda. I've added a short line item to the notes so nobody is surprised by the amount, and I'll forward the updated quote if the vendor sends one. Sorry for the shuffle, especially since you already blocked time. The delay is on our side, not on the vendor, and once the charge is cleared I'll keep you posted without waiting for the usual meeting. If you need me to confirm something urgently before then, please just send a quick message and I'll pick it up first. I know the sprint review is close, so I'll mark the budget change as provisional unless the vendor revises it by end of day. Thank you for staying flexible today.
